title: Folk Theorems for Social Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.25280v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study repeated games with purely informational externalities. Each player observes a single conditionally independent signal and then repeatedly takes publicly observed actions to maximize their expected discounted payoff, which depends only on the state and their own action. We show that, when there are sufficiently many players and they are sufficiently patient, there exist equilibria where information is aggregated: the players' payoffs approximate the full-information payoff. This holds even if actions are uninformative under myopic play. Conversely, even if myopic play reveals the state, there also exist equilibria where information is not aggregated: payoffs approximate those under autarky. Our results speak to the range of possible outcomes of social learning games with forward-looking agents.

translated_title: 社会学习的无名氏定理
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有纯信息外部性的重复博弈。每个参与者观察一个条件独立的信号，随后反复采取公开可观察的行动，以最大化其预期折现收益，该收益仅取决于状态和参与者自身的行动。我们证明，当参与者数量足够多且足够有耐心时，存在信息得以加总的均衡：参与者的收益近似于完全信息下的收益。即使在新近（短视）博弈下行动不包含信息，这一结论依然成立。反之，即使短视博弈能够揭示真实状态，也存在信息未能加总的均衡：收益近似于自给自足状态下的水平。我们的结果刻画了具有前瞻性参与者的社会学习博弈可能出现的各种均衡结果的范围。
tldr: 该论文证明，在具有纯信息外部性的重复博弈中，当参与者足够多且足够耐心时，既存在信息完全加总的均衡（即使短视行为本身不携带信息），也存在信息不加总的均衡（即使短视行为能揭示状态），从而刻画了前瞻性主体的社会学习结果的多重可能性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in repeated games with purely informational externalities, when there are sufficiently many patient players, equilibria exist both with information aggregation (even if myopic actions are uninformative) and without it (even if myopic play reveals the state), characterizing the range of possible outcomes of social learning with forward-looking agents.
